newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU-15 feed output rose 0.7 pct in 1996 - FEFAC.
newsitem.headline: EU-15 feed output rose 0.7 pct in 1996 - FEFAC.

text.p: Production of compound animal feed in 15 European Union member states rose 0.7 percent to 120.2 million tonnes in 1996, the European Feed Manufacturers' Association said.
Pig feed production showed the strongest increase, growing by three percent to 41.5 million tonnes. Poultry feed rose by 1.9 percent to 34.0 million tonnes.
But cattle feed output fell by 2.8 percent to 34.7 million tonnes due to mad cow disease.

Austrian compound feed production surged by 14.2 percent while increases of 3.7 percent and 2.4 percent were recorded in France and Germany respectively. In Britain and Denmark, output rose by 1.6 percent, while Belgium recorded a 1.5 percent rise.
But Irish feed production was 6.1 percent lower and decreases of 2.5 percent and 1.8 percent were recorded in Italy and the Netherlands.
Production in other countries was little changed.
